svg.title: Prefetch actions name a future record
svg.desc: The running record's sixteen-word window contains only property lines A and B. B is current and A first appears at lead one, so neither Full14 nor Scale6 issues a prefetch for this record. A second flow contrasts Full14's offline encoded lead with Scale6's runtime selection from record bytes. Both decode the target vertex from the selected future record and apply resident, pending and admission filters.
svg.text: Prefetch actions name a future record
Reference distance predicts this line's reuse; a prefetch lead selects another record's property.
lookahead starts at the same CSR position j18
B is the current line. A first appears at +1, before the eligible window. Later A/B entries are not new candidates.
Full14 action = 0; Scale6 selected lead = 0. No extra read for this record.
TWO WAYS TO SELECT A LEAD
choose a format, not an additional edge stream
then next-use distance, then proximity to lead 10
first distinct line at a lead in 8..15
tie: closest to lead 10; no action field
reuse distance is not the target ID
functional model; native delivery is not implemented
Primary model: 8-request latency, at most 1 issue per 8 governed requests. FlowThrough is OFF.
Useful prefetches can reduce demand misses; only total reads plus writebacks establish the traffic cost.
